title: Curry
description:
Implement a `curry` function that transforms a binary function (two arguments) into a curried form.

**Example:**
```js
const add = (a, b) => a + b;
const curriedAdd = curry(add);
curriedAdd(1)(2) // 3
curriedAdd(5)(10) // 15
```
ai_context: Learners often try to build a generic variadic curry instead of the simpler binary form. For a binary curry, two nested closures is all you need. A subtle pitfall: forgetting that each partial application must return a new function, not share state with other partial applications.
